feedback: The onboarding process was smooth and my team made me feel welcome from day one.
Great work-life balance with flexible WFH options. Really appreciate the trust.
My manager provides clear guidance and regular feedback which helps me grow.
The learning reimbursement program helped me complete my AWS certification.
Team collaboration tools work well and communication across departments is effective.
Company culture is inclusive and team events are well organized.
Health insurance coverage for my family gives me peace of mind.
Received a fair performance bonus that reflected my contributions this year.
The HR portal makes leave applications and payroll queries very easy.
Training sessions on new technologies are informative and well structured.
Promotion process was transparent and I received constructive feedback throughout.
Office facilities are clean and the cafeteria offers good meal options.
Salary is often delayed by a few days past the promised credit date.
Workload has increased significantly without additional resources or support.
Communication from leadership during the restructuring was unclear and delayed.
The approval process for WFH requests takes too long and is inconsistent.
Overtime hours are not always compensated despite prior manager approval.
Performance review criteria were changed mid-cycle without proper explanation.
IT support response time for laptop issues is unacceptably slow.
Limited career growth opportunities in my department over the past two years.
The office parking situation has become worse with no solutions offered.
Mandatory weekend work was announced with very short notice last month.
HR helpdesk did not respond to my payroll query for over a week.
Team morale has dropped since the recent layoffs were handled poorly.
The new attendance tracking system frequently shows incorrect records.
Project deadlines are reasonable most of the time but can get tight near releases.
The office location is convenient but commute during peak hours is lengthy.
Standard company benefits are adequate though not exceptional compared to industry.
Daily standup meetings are useful but sometimes run longer than necessary.
Documentation for internal tools exists but could be more detailed and updated.
The dress code policy is standard for IT companies and easy to follow.
Cafeteria food quality varies day to day but is generally acceptable.
Annual leave policy is in line with what I expected when I joined.
The probation review process was straightforward with clear expectations.
Company holiday calendar covers major festivals but optional holidays are limited.
